text:
Never Lose a Job to a Dead Signal Again

Every field service company has a horror story: a technician loses signal in a basement, the app freezes, and by the time it reconnects, the job's gone -- or worse, gotten double-booked. Waypoint was built to make that story impossible.

Under the hood, every action a technician takes -- every photo, every status update, every signature -- gets written straight to the Job Event Store, the single source of truth for what actually happened on a job, whether you're standing in a fiber-connected office building or three floors underground with zero bars. Nothing waits on a network round-trip to be real.

That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole reason our customers tell us they've cut missed appointments in half since switching. When your technicians never lose a job to a dead zone, your customers stop losing patience with you.

We built Waypoint around one value that never changes, no matter how many features we ship: Customer Trust. Every login screen, every offline sync, every dashboard alert -- all of it exists in service of one thing: making sure the promise you made to a customer actually gets kept.

Try it risk-free for thirty days. Once your dispatchers see it, they'll wonder how they ever ran a business without it.
